description: This file contains JavaScript code for managing dynamic menus in the SuiteCRM interface, including functions for showing, hiding, positioning menus, handling browser compatibility, and user interactions.

methods.name: eraseTimeout
methods.description: Clears a timeout given its ID.

methods.name: tbButtonMouseOverOrig
methods.description: Handles mouse over event on a toolbar button, showing its menu.

methods.name: tbButtonMouseOver
methods.description: Sets a delayed show for a menu when mouse hovers over a button.

methods.name: showMenu
methods.description: Displays a menu at specified position.

methods.name: showSubMenu
methods.description: Displays a submenu.

methods.name: popupMenu
methods.description: Positions and makes a menu visible.

methods.name: popupSubMenu
methods.description: Positions and makes a submenu visible.

methods.name: closeMenusOrig
methods.description: Closes the current menu.

methods.name: closeSubMenus
methods.description: Closes submenus related to a handle.

methods.name: closeMenu
methods.description: Closes a specific menu.

methods.name: closeMenus
methods.description: Sets a timeout to close all menus.

methods.name: closeAllMenus
methods.description: Closes all open menus.

methods.name: setMenuVisible
methods.description: Sets visibility and position of a menu.

methods.name: getLayer
methods.description: Retrieves a DOM element by ID.

methods.name: setMenuVisibility
methods.description: Sets the visibility of a menu element.

methods.name: setLayer
methods.description: Sets position and visibility of a layer.

methods.name: setLayerElm
methods.description: Applies style changes to a layer element.

methods.name: hiliteItem
methods.description: Highlights a menu item.

methods.name: unhiliteItem
methods.description: Removes highlight from a menu item.

methods.name: showElement
methods.description: Makes elements visible by tag name.

methods.name: showElementNew
methods.description: Restores visibility of elements from stack.

methods.name: hideElement
methods.description: Hides elements based on position and size.

methods.name: Is
methods.description: Browser detection class.

methods.name: runPageLoadItems
methods.description: Initializes page-specific scripts.
